audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 5 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] both say Sett is ahead; row 6 read Skill while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Sylas out-scales.
audit.why: The packet chart gives Sett rows 0-5 and Sylas row 6, which is exactly what the page's own prose describes at a 53.08% win rate over 4708 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 carried no numbers on either ultimate, and spikes[1].text claimed Sett's R 'out-suppresses his stolen ults'.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s against The Show Stopper's 120/100/80s — he gets a stolen ult roughly twice per one of yours, and that ratio is the actual level-6 story. Suppression is not described anywhere in Sett's kit text.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten with both cooldowns; the suppression claim dropped.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond's recast was described as a disengage — wants.foe[1] literally says he uses it 'to disengage your all-in'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Sylas dashes to a location, and can recast to throw his chains out, PULLING HIMSELF TO an enemy he hits. The recast closes distance onto you; it cannot take him away. And The Show Stopper grounds, which denies both Abscond halves and Kingslayer's lunge.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.foe[1], with Abscond at 13s rank 1.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond: 13s at rank 1 — the recast pulls HIM to you, so it is an engage, not an escape. Your R grounds both halves.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 13s at rank 1, and the recast drags him to you — that is your window, not his escape.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — E-stun into the W panel.
edits.after: The Show Stopper grounds Abscond and Kingslayer's lunge — cash it when he tries to leave, then E-stun into the W panel.

notes: Riot's text for Abscond/Abduct describes only the dash and the self-pull; the kit's derived flags list projectile and dash but no hardCC, so I did not repeat the page's 'dash + stun' wording — whether Abduct stuns is not in this data and is recorded in unverified. The recast-is-an-engage correction stands on the text alone. Mirror not yet audited.
